Mahkato Mdewakanton Association

The Mahkato Mdewakanton Association organizes the Mahkato Wacipi in Mankato. The association shares Dakota history and culture through the gathering and describes its work as part of reconciliation between Dakota and non-Dakota communities.

Names & relationships

The association identifies Land of Memories Park in Mankato as the venue for Mahkato Wacipi and describes school and public learning programs held alongside the gathering.

Selected reading

01

Wacipi and public education

The association records school outreach and a learning tent at the Wacipi where Native presenters shared cultural knowledge with visitors. The gathering takes place at Land of Memories Park.
